confidence_notes: Restaurant meal anchors rest on aggregated Seattle price figures, mostly Numbeo-derived and Expatistan-style crowd-sourced data, so they are moderately reliable. Beer and cappuccino are supported by these aggregates but are less precise. The cocktail anchor is a bounded estimate from a nightlife-guide range and one aggregate. The wine_glass anchor is weak: no citywide restaurant-by-the-glass average was found, so it is set at about 1.5 times the beer anchor, informed by a retail bottle price of about $17. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Seattle context, with no accommodation search and no live listings checked. Hostel and hotel figures could plausibly vary by 25 percent or more with season and neighborhood.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors are Seattle-specific for food and drink, drawing on aggregated Seattle price data, with the wine glass derived from the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a large US Pacific Northwest metro in July 2026.
